biography.value:
Published alignment: NG/NE.

Description

Scales the color of topaz armor this ferocious young dragon while crowned with large pointy horns.

Defense

AC 22, touch 15, flat-footed 17 (+7 natural, +5 dex)

hp 94 (9d12+27)

mp 40

Fort +9, Ref +12, Will +7

DR 5/magic; Immune Lightning, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Water 50%

Weakness Earth

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 150 ft. (poor)

Melee Bite +13 (1d8+4), 2 Claws +12 (1d6+3), 2 wings +7 (1d4+1)

Special Attacks Blaster, Breath Weapon (60-ft. line, 4d10 lightning damage, Reflex DC 17 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)

Special Abilities Lightning Armor

Spells Known (FC CL 9th, Concentration +14)

At will - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 16) - spark, thunder

2nd (DC 17) - elemental resistance, see invisibility, spark II, thunder II

3rd (DC 18) - dispel, haste, spark III, thundara, thunder III

Statistics

Str 16, Dex 20, Con 16, Int 20, Wis 9, Cha 12

Base Atk +9; CMB +12; CMD 32 (36 vs. trip)

Feats Combat Casting, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Appraise +15, Bluff +13, Fly +17, Intimidate +13, Knowledge (arcana, dungeoneering) +15, Perception +11, Sense Motive +11, Spellcraft +15, Stealth +17, Survival +11

Languages Auran, Common, Draconic + 4 others (DM's choice)

ffd20-bestiary-builder.sourceText: Breath Weapon (60-ft. line, 4d10 lightning damage, Reflex DC 17 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)

description.value: As a standard action, a yellow dragon can send out a pulse of electricity through its whiskers at a single target within 30 ft. The yellow dragon must make a ranged touch attack (+14), if it hits, the target takes 3d6 points of lightning damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 19) or be inflicted with Immobilize status for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

effect: Full damage on hit; save negates immobilization for 1d4 rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a yellow dragon grants herself a shocking barrier as a standard action. All allies can gain the effect of Shock Spikes. The allies must be within 30 feet of yellow dragon when it uses this ability to receive these bonuses for 6 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

effect: Transfer Lightning Armor: Shock Spikes to each protected ally. Use either the recipient's Retaliate or the grantor's retaliation roll, never both. The recipient copy uses this statblock's caster level; for an advanced grantor use its own retaliation action.
Only after a protected ally is hit with a natural weapon, unarmed strike or handheld weapon. Roll once per qualifying hit.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: A yellow dragon can see through fog, clouds, and similar obscuring effects with perfect clarity.

effect: See through fog, clouds and similar obscuring effects with perfect clarity.

description.value: On a successful natural, unarmed, or handheld weapon hit against the recipient, deal 1d6 to the attacker.

effect: Only after a protected ally is hit with a natural weapon, unarmed strike or handheld weapon. Roll once per qualifying hit.

description.value: Failed save only.
